{{Quote|The truth is we've been fighting a losing battle here&mdash;and I expected these withdrawal orders long before the treaty talks ever began.|Buryn, during the Battle of Balmorra|<ref name="The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 2: New Galactic Order">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 2: New Galactic Order]]''</ref>}}
'''Buryn''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3653 BBY]], he served as the theater commander for the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]]&mdash;a long-running conflict between the Republic and the Empire over the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] rich resources and manufacturing capabilities. During the fight for [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], the [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire extended an offer of peace to the Republic. Upon the acceptance of the offer and the ratification and enactment of the Great War-ending [[Treaty of Coruscant]], all Republic Military forces were expected to stand down, including those belonging to General Buryn on Balmorra.

As the Togruta tried to gather his [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] and leave the battlefield, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Fortris Gall]] rebelled against the General and the Treaty by launching a covert rescue mission into a Sith [[Troida Military Workshop|military base]]. Gall's brazen attack forced Buryn and his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to remain on-planet, turning the mire of the Balmorra battle into one of the earliest conflicts of the post-Great Galactic War [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|political unrest]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Lieutenant Tavus, Master Orgus, we welcome your arrival''"<br />"''Rather than our arrival, General, we need to discuss why you're not preparing for ''departure''."''<br />"''We missed the deadline waiting for Fortris to free some of our captured soldiers. The Imperials attacked, and we've been stuck here ever since.|General Buryn and Jedi Master Orgus Din|<ref name="The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 2: New Galactic Order" />}}
After the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was signed, Buryn was present at [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Base 11A]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] with several Jedi, discussing the troop withdrawal orders given after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Fortris Gall]] had been planning a rescue mission to liberate [[Demolitions Squad 419]] from captivity by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. After Buryn discouraged Fortris from attempting a rescue, Fortris left the room, claiming to merely be going outside to look at the [[Star/Legends|stars]].

In actuality, Fortris departed for the [[Troida Military Workshop]] where Squad 419 was being held. After defeating a Sith guard in a duel, Fortris succeeded in liberating the captive demolitions team.
